blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — What renders the 1987 Constitution futile is when Filipinos begin defending acts of corruptions by “nefarious political idols” and normalizing unlawful execution of innocent people, the Palace said Saturday. READ: Lawyers, deans back impeach court ruling on ‘2/3’ threshold Palace press officer Claire Castro made the pronouncement amid criticisms against the Senate impeachment court’s recent ruling modifying the two-thirds conviction threshold on Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. “The Senate has its own mandate, and conducting an impeachment trial falls squarely within its jurisdiction,” Castro said. “This will be the real scenario… our Constitution will be rendered futile […]...
